summary: Technically Complete A Process Order Only After All Mandatory Quality

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can access the "Confirm Process Order" Fiori app and select "Technical Completion."
The system checks for any open deviations, missing in-process control results, or unsigned batch record sections before allowing completion.
The system blocks technical completion and lists the specific outstanding items if any requirement is unmet.
Once all requirements are satisfied, the system allows technical completion and updates the order status accordingly.
The finished goods batch remains in Quality Inspection stock status until QA formally releases it, independent of technical completion.
The system logs the user and timestamp of technical completion for audit purposes.

HP.description: Technical completion of a process order with all quality and documentation requirements met - All deviations closed, all IPC results recorded, all batch record sections signed, order status updates to TECO, stock remains in QI, audit log created

NEG.description: Attempt TECO with open deviations linked to the process order
Attempt TECO with missing in-process control results for required inspection characteristics
Attempt TECO with unsigned mandatory batch record sections

ERR.description: Attempt TECO with non-existent process order number
Attempt TECO without required authorization (missing TECO function in user role)

EDGE.description: Process order with zero open deviations (boundary case: exactly 0 vs 1+)
Process order with exactly one open deviation (boundary case: 1 vs 0)
Process order already technically completed (attempt duplicate TECO)

INT.description: Verify stock status remains QI after TECO and does not auto-transition to UR without QA release — Module: MM Stock Status
Verify open deviations from QM Deviation Management block TECO — Module: QM Deviation Management
Verify missing IPC results from QM In-Process Control block TECO — Module: QM In-Process Control
Verify unsigned batch record sections from e-Signature module block TECO — Module: Custom e-Signature
Verify QM inspection lot status is not affected by TECO (QA release is separate) — Module: QM Inspection Lot
